stemMd: A rectangular box has edge lengths 2 cm, 3 cm and 6 cm. What is the length of its space diagonal?
explanationMd: The squared space diagonal is the sum of squared perpendicular edge lengths: 2² + 3² + 6² = 49. Taking the square root gives 7 cm. This extends Pythagoras to three dimensions.

distractorRationale.a: This adds edge lengths rather than using three-dimensional Pythagoras.
distractorRationale.b: This is the diagonal of only the 2-by-3 face.
